variants.summaryLt: Rasta reta PALB2 geno atmaina. Šis genas padeda taisyti DNR pažeidimus. Toks pokytis gali didinti paveldimos vėžio rizikos tikimybę šeimoje — tai ne diagnozė, o signalas aptarti su gydytoju genetiku.
variants.summaryEn: A rare PALB2 variant was found. This gene helps repair DNA damage. Such a change can raise hereditary cancer risk in a family — not a diagnosis, but a signal to discuss with a clinical geneticist.

variants.summaryLt: Rasta RYR1 geno atmaina, siejama su padidėjusiu jautrumu kai kurioms anestezijos medžiagoms (piktybinė hipertermija). Prieš operacijas svarbu apie tai informuoti anesteziologą.
variants.summaryEn: An RYR1 variant linked to increased sensitivity to certain anesthetics (malignant hyperthermia risk) was found. Tell your anesthesiologist before surgery.

syntheticNotice: Derived from synthetic demonstration VCF. Not for clinical use.
